gate: WP-21 failure semantics for the API and the database

determinism.sortOrder: sections by id, checks by (area, name), matrix rows by id, breakers by dependency
determinism.note: No timestamp and no run id is recorded. The artifact must be byte-identical for an identical set of outcomes, so a clock reading would make every diff meaningless.

database.note: Every row of the matrix is driven by a synthetic error object, so the gate does not need a live database and cannot be made to fail by breaking one.

breakers.declared: conversation plane down → continuity pipeline or SMS
Redis down → conservative in-process limits logged as degraded

matrix.required: Retry the transaction up to three times with jitter.
matrix.observed: recovered after 2 retries; always-deadlocking transaction attempted 4 times (3 jittered retries) then answered 409

matrix.required: Alert; the audit chain must never be the write that fails.
matrix.observed: 70% → elevated + alert(data_volume_at_70pct) + 503; 95% → critical, refuses [bulk_export, read_model_rebuild] while audit_chain stays admitted first in the priority order at every level
409 reference_conflict naming orgId (driver) / caseRef (Prisma meta.field_name); the offending value and the table name are never published

matrix.required: Shed with 503 and Retry-After; do not queue indefinitely behind a connection.
Read-only degraded mode: serve reads, explicitly REFUSE new interventions.
matrix.observed: reads allowed, interventionsAllowed=false, zero write attempts, refusal 409 intervention_refused_degraded (retryable=false, fallback=sms); full outage → 503 + Retry-After

matrix.required: Fail reads back to primary or show a staleness banner.
matrix.observed: 120 ms → replica, not stale; 9 400 ms → primary (failedBack) or replica + banner{lagMs:9400,thresholdMs:2000}; default mode is fail_back
same runner, same constant (3 retries / 4 attempts), exhausted → 409

matrix.required: Typed timeout error, never a hanging request.
matrix.observed: abandoned at budget with DbTimeoutError inside the 5 s assertion bound; 503 + Retry-After 5; own errors propagate unchanged

matrix.required: Route to the idempotency response or a typed 409, never a 500.
matrix.observed: stored answer present → replay 200; absent, no store, or non-2xx → 409 unique_conflict; no path returns 500

policyRefusal.note: WP-2 policy-gate steps 5 (spend ceiling) and 6 (credit reservation) are comments, so runPolicyGate cannot produce those two codes yet. They are declared in POLICY_REFUSAL_CODES and are asserted here so the mapping is complete the day they are implemented.
policyRefusal.contrast: internal_bug is the only code that yields 500

staticCheck.rule: no network I/O inside a database transaction
staticCheck.method: comments and string literals are blanked (offsets preserved), every $transaction( region is bracket-matched, and the region is searched for a declared network-token vocabulary

negativeControl.fixture: synthetic $transaction(async tx => { await fetch(...); await tx.case.create(...) })
negativeControl.cleanFixture: same fetch() placed outside the transaction reports nothing
negativeControl.commentsAndStrings: a comment and a string literal mentioning fetch() inside a transaction are not reported

limits: regex literals are not blanked, so a regex containing a network token would be reported (false positive, fails loudly)
a dynamically-computed callee name is not detected
a network call made by a FUNCTION CALLED from inside a transaction is not detected; the modules that can reach the network are named above for manual review

edges.why: the chain append is bounded by its own client pool and must not inherit the request budget

edges.source: declared here — no per-call budget exists on the ingest path
edges.why: state transition plus outbox row must commit inside the request budget
a fan-out that has not landed in time degrades the console, never the request

edges.source: declared here — src/lib/outbox.ts deliver() sets no timeout on its fetch
edges.why: a webhook call with no budget is the one hang the worker cannot shed around

edges.source: declared here — the claim query runs on the shared pool
edges.why: a claim must either take its rows or release them, never hang holding SKIP LOCKED leases
an agent turn must leave room for synthesis and playback inside the same turn window
the call request must land before the turn window closes
a dial that has not been placed leaves the turn silent with nothing queued
synthesis is the last thing to finish before audio is played back

timeouts.rule: every outbound call is strictly shorter than the caller waiting on it
